commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay <<'REPLAY_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv
lock=$base/.replay.lock

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"

if ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' 'replay is already running' >&2
    exit 1
fi
trap 'rmdir "$lock"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

if [ ! -f "$index" ]; then
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"
fi

is_recorded()
{
    awk -F '\t' -v wanted="$1" 'NR > 1 && $1 == wanted { found = 1; exit } END { exit !found }' "$index"
}

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    name=${message##*/}
    message_id=$(awk '
        /^[[:space:]]*$/ { exit }
        /^[Mm][Ee][Ss][Ss][Aa][Gg][Ee]-[Ii][Dd]:[[:space:]]*/ {
            sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, "")
            sub(/\r$/, "")
            sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "")
            print
            exit
        }
    ' "$message")

    case $message_id in
        '')
            cp -p -- "$message" "$quarantine/$name"
            printf '%s\n' 'Malformed message: missing Message-ID header.' > "$quarantine/$name.reason"
            printf 'quarantined\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" 'missing Message-ID header'
            continue
            ;;
        *'\t'*|*' '* )
            cp -p -- "$message" "$quarantine/$name"
            printf '%s\n' 'Malformed message: invalid Message-ID header.' > "$quarantine/$name.reason"
            printf 'quarantined\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" 'invalid Message-ID header'
            continue
            ;;
    esac

    if is_recorded "$message_id"; then
        printf 'skipped\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$name"
        continue
    fi

    target=$name
    if [ -e "$delivered/$target" ]; then
        stem=${name%.eml}
        suffix=1
        while [ -e "$delivered/${stem}-$suffix.eml" ]; do
            suffix=$((suffix + 1))
        done
        target=${stem}-$suffix.eml
    fi

    tmp=$delivered/.replay.$$
    cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp"
    mv -- "$tmp" "$delivered/$target"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$target" >> "$index"
    printf 'delivered\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$target"
done
REPLAY_EOF
chmod 755 /srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay
sh -n /srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay
printf 'installed-posix-replay\n'

set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication
printf 'FIRST RUN\n'
./bin/replay
printf 'INDEX AFTER FIRST RUN\n'
cat delivered/index.tsv
printf 'DELIVERED IDS\n'
for f in delivered/*.eml; do printf '%s\t' "${f##*/}"; awk '/^[Mm][Ee][Ss][Ss][Aa][Gg][Ee]-[Ii][Dd]:/{sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/,""); print; exit}' "$f"; done
printf 'QUARANTINE\n'
find quarantine -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' | sort
printf 'REASON\n'
cat quarantine/bad.eml.reason
printf 'SPOOL HASHES\n'
sha256sum spool/*.eml | sort
